messages:
morgan: Heads-up — we got a customer report: a bunch of fncall->tool invocations are getting schema 'soft' rejects, then routing to a fallback model, and the console shows "billing: charged" for the whole request. Is that expected?

jamie: Ugh. Not expected. We intended to not bill for downstream tool tokens when a fncall is rejected before the adapter executes. What part of the pipeline is marking it billed?

anish: Most likely the meter gets incremented when the top-level response is emitted, we currently tag billing at response flush time. If fallback generates the final tokens, it's counting them. We didn't differentiate rejected-tool vs fallback tokens.

priya: We should decide: 1) don't bill any tool tokens for requests where schema validation flagged the tool response as invalid; or 2) bill only up to the point of failure (prompt + model processing) but not the adapter/tool execution. Customer expectation leans to (2) imo.

morgan: For contracts, enterprise customers will complain if they see huge tool call bills for invalid outputs. Need console/telemetry to make this obvious ASAP.

anish: Proposal: add a metric label fncall_schema.reject_type="soft|hard" and fncall_billing.stage="pre-tool|post-tool|fallback". Then dashboard can show split of charged tokens by stage.

jamie: Sounds good. Also need an event when we perform a coercion/soft-accept if we've implemented adapters that auto-coerce bad shapes. Tag as fncall_schema.action="coerce" so billing logic knows.

priya: For rollout UX, I'd like a per-customer flag: `billing.exclude_invalid_tool_tokens=true` behind a feature-flag + canary. We can enable for a few tenants and watch cost delta.

morgan: Implementation detail: do we have the token accounting granularity to subtract tool-execution tokens retroactively if we switch the flag? Backfill billing will be painful.

anish: We do emit token counts per stage already, stored in proto, but invoice pipeline expects cumulative tokens. We can add a translation layer: invoice_pipeline.apply_exclusions(feature_flags) before finalizing. Not trivial but feasible.

jamie: Dashboard: add a short panel in Console > Routes > {route} that shows "fncall reject rate" and a bar for "charged tokens (prompt|model|tool)" with a tooltip that shows how many of those were due to soft vs hard rejects.

morgan: Also need alerting: spike in fncall_schema.rejects correlated with sudden tool token charges -> slack alert to #eng-billing.

priya: Quick telemetry query for engineers to debug — suggest adding this to the ops cookbook: ```
sum by(reject_type) (rate(fncall_schema_reject_total[5m]))
sum(rate(tokens_charged_total{stage!="prompt"}[5m])) by (stage)
```

morgan: Who will own the console change? Jamie?

jamie: I can pick up the Console panel. Will need a new PromQL endpoint for the combined metric. Estimated 2 sprint days + 1 for QA.

anish: I'll own the billing tagging and proto changes. I'll add labels and ensure mediator emits per-stage token counts.

priya: I'll draft the feature flag and rollout plan for excluding invalid tool tokens from billing. Also write the Slack alert rule.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: fncall-metrics-labels v1.2 -> canary infra-ctx at 2025-09-12T18:30Z :rocket:

morgan: Great — let's do a quick post-deploy checklist: 1) validate labels appear in metrics 2) console panel shows expected split 3) run sample tenant with flag enabled and compare invoices.

anish: I'll post follow-up with the proto diff and sample infra metric once deploy is up.

jamie: Thanks — tagging @product to track customer-facing messaging. :thumbsup:
